jobs.description:
What is a Business Analyst in insurance domain at cream?

As Stella, Business Analyst (in Insurance Domain), embrace your role and support the different applications in the insurance industry (life and non life). You will be the liaison among business and IT teams.
Your tasks

• Participate and lead requirements gathering sessions with clients

• Produce Functional Design and Requirements Specification documents on domains of expertise e.g. New Business, Claims, etc.

• Implement, in means of configuration, relevant aspects of the client's requirements

• Write/ Review test plans

• Perform expert testing and defect management following development/configuration

• Conduct training sessions on the system and its configured product set

• Production support including UAT testing, defect analysis and Change Requests management

• Perform gap analysis

• You have a Master degree or equivalent experience

• Minimum 5 years of experience: ideally 3 or more years of experience within an insurance company

• You have proven experience as a Business Analyst

• You can meet project deadlines and provide high-quality deliverables

• You have a cultural openness and adaptability, you are rigorous, customer-oriented and you have high communications skills and analytical skills

• You are able to work with autonomy while being also a great team player

• You are fluent in French and a good command of English, Dutch is a plus

• You are committed to travelling abroad occasionally upon the client's request

Bedrijfsomschrijving 

Our client is a leading player in the event industry, specialized in the design and production of exhibition stand systems. The company is known for its innovative approach and high-quality products that are used worldwide at trade fairs, exhibitions, and events.

Are you experienced in operating sawing machines and working with aluminium profiles? As a Saw Operator, you will cut aluminium profiles according to technical drawings and ensure that every piece meets the required quality standards.

You will work in a modern production environment in Roeselare, alternating between series production, one-off production and special pieces. You will work in a 2-shift system and use an ERP system to process production orders.

Your main tasks include:

 
• 
Reading technical drawings and determining how the pieces need to be cut.

 
• 
Setting up the sawing machine, including the required lengths and cutting angles.

 
• 
Cutting aluminium profiles for series production, one-off production and special pieces.

 
• 
Checking your own work using gauges and measuring tools such as a tape measure and caliper.

 
• 
Recording quality checks on inspection sheets.

 
• 
Processing production orders in the ERP system Business Central – Propos.

 
• 
Communicating relevant information during shift handovers.

 
• 
Carrying out first-line maintenance, such as cleaning the machine and replacing saw blades.

 
• 
Supporting other workstations when necessary.

 
• 
You have experience as a Operator.

 
• 
You can read technical drawings related to sawing and cutting components.

 
• 
You can work with measuring tools such as a tape measure and caliper.

 
• 
You can speak English. This is a requirement for the position.

 
• 
Basic knowledge of Dutch, both spoken and written, is an advantage.

 
• 
Working in a 2-shift system suits you.

 
• 
You work accurately and check the quality of your own work.

 
• 
You keep your workplace clean and organised.

 
• 
Experience with an ERP system is an advantage.

Our client is a key player in the healthcare and social services sector. The work environment is dynamic, collaborative, and innovation-driven, with a strong focus on modernizing its IT landscape and continuously improving operational performance. 
They are looking for a Senior Network Infrastructure Engineer to join a team responsible for the implementation, maintenance, support, and administration of the network infrastructure.
This includes network hardware, PCs and servers, printers and other peripherals, as well as the core software installed on them, both at the head office and across around one hundred remote sites.

Jobomschrijving

• Implement, maintain, and administer the organization's network infrastructure, including network hardware, servers, PCs, printers, peripherals, and foundational software.
• Support the helpdesk on complex technical issues and provide advanced assistance to end users.
• Monitor system performance, conduct tuning activities, and ensure the stability and reliability of all network and server environments.
• Participate in a 24/7 on-call rotation to guarantee operational continuity.
• Collaborate with software development teams and intervene on existing applications when needed.
• Mentor and support junior team members, sharing best practices and helping them develop technical skills.
• Analyze technical needs and contribute to the design, documentation, and implementation of new technical solutions.
• Ensure the security, resilience, and scalability of the IT infrastructure across all sites.
• Stay up to date with relevant technologies and propose improvements to enhance the IT landscape.

Education & Experience

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field.
• Minimum 10 years of proven experience in a similar role with demonstrated progression.
• Valid driving license (Category B).
• You have a good command of technical English and a passive knowledge of Dutch (you can understand Dutch-speaking participants during meetings and work based on documentation written in Dutch).

Technical Skills

• Strong expertise in managing a Windows 11 desktop fleet and related peripherals.
• Solid knowledge of Microsoft Windows Server 2019/2022.
• Good overall knowledge of Linux.
• Strong understanding of LAN/WAN configuration.
• Knowledge of relational databases.

Assets (Nice to Have)

• Experience with Aruba switches.
• Knowledge of Red Hat Enterprise 9, JBoss, Docker.
• Knowledge of PostgreSQL and MS SQL Server.
• Experience with VMware ESX virtualization.
• Basic software development knowledge.
• Experience creating MSI packages and scripting in PHP.
• Knowledge of Office 365 administration.

Our client is building one of the most advanced glass factories in the world in Lommel. This ultramodern site excels in sustainability, automation, and technological innovation. As a TECHNICIAN, you play a key role in the maintenance and operation of this state-of-the-art production environment, where safety, efficiency, and environmental awareness are at the forefront.

Jobomschrijving

Well before the startup, you will begin thorough training in day shifts to fully understand our installations, systems, and standards, enabling you to help set the standard in this unique factory from day one.

Depending on your background (electrical or mechanical), you will be deployed as a technician within one of the maintenance teams. Your tasks will include:
	
• Analyzing and resolving technical faults in machines and installations	
• Performing preventive and corrective maintenance	
• Calibrating, adjusting, and checking parts and systems	
• Contributing ideas for technical improvements within your department	
• Working closely with fellow technicians and operators for safe and stable operation	
• Accurately recording interventions in the maintenance system

Profile:
	
• You have completed technical training or have relevant experience in maintenance	
• You are strong in mechanical and/or electrical areas	
• You are solution-oriented and enjoy working in a team	
• You are skilled in reading technical plans or schematics	
• You can work in a day-shift and are looking for a stable, long-term challenge	
• You speak good English.

Company Activities:

Join a company committed to excellence in maritime operations. Our client prides themselves on their dedication to safety, innovation, and teamwork. Their mission is to deliver top-notch dredging services with a focus on environmental sustainability and client satisfaction. As part of their team, you’ll be contributing to projects that shape the waterways of northern Europe, ensuring they remain navigable and efficient for all maritime traffic.

Jobomschrijving

Are you a skilled Captain for Tugboat looking for an exciting opportunity to showcase your expertise? Join our client’s dynamic team and navigate the waters of northern France and Belgium. Your primary mission will be to provide essential support to a dredging pontoon, ensuring smooth operations and safe passage through these regions.

Key Responsibilities:
	
• Navigate and operate the tugboat efficiently in collaboration with dredging operations.	
• Ensure the mechanical upkeep of the tugboat, supported by the client’s team of technicians.	
• Maintain tidiness and order on board, ensuring a safe and pleasant environment.	
• Coordinate with French-speaking and Flemish-speaking teams to ensure seamless communication and operations.

Profile Description:

Our client is seeking an independent and responsible individual to take on the role of Captain for Tugboat. The ideal candidate will possess:
	
• A strong mechanical knowledge, essential for the maintenance and operation of the tugboat.	
• CRR holder credentials.	
• A driving licence and access to a car for easy mobility.	
• A B licence (river) and A licence (river + coastal) to navigate various waterways.	
• Proficiency in English, French, or Dutch to effectively communicate with diverse teams.

Company Activities

Our client is more than just a packaging glass producer. They are a family business with an international outlook, driven by technology, sustainability, and people. 

In our client’s IS Department (Glass Forming Department, Hot End), molten glass arrives from the glass furnace, where it is cut into gobs and transported via the feeder to the production line. The glass gob then drops into a mould, where it is blown into shape and coated with a hot-end coating. Within this department, you will play a key role in operating, monitoring, and adjusting the process while ensuring quality and efficiency.

Jobomschrijving

As an Operator within the production department of our client, you will find yourself at the beating heart of their glass organization. 

We do provide housing.

We do not provide work permits.

Key responsibilities:
	
• Ensure the smooth operation of the production process by controlling and monitoring gob control systems, the lehr, and conveyor systems, adjusting process parameters, and checking temperature values.	
• Prepare the required equipment prior to production changeovers and replace refractory components when needed.	
• Clean and maintain machinery, installations, and the working environment.	
• Identify, report, and accurately document technical malfunctions and process deviations.	
• Monitor product quality by carrying out inspections and measurements (including weight, heat, and temperature checks) and maintaining records such as process data, mould numbers, and production settings.	
• Provide a thorough shift handover to the incoming team at the end of your shift.

The following criteria are important:
	
• Experience in a production environment.	
• Willingness to attend training sessions during the day at various training locations.	
• Ability to work with a computer.	
• Good command of English or Dutch.	
• Actively contribute to a pleasant team atmosphere and be helpful to colleagues.	
• Flexible with the task package, especially during the startup phase.	
• No issues with working in a warm environment (temperatures up to 40 degrees).	
• Physical work does not deter you.	
• Basic technical knowledge.

Our client is a leading industrial manufacturing company investing in the expansion and modernization of one of its production sites.

Jobomschrijving

• Coordinate engineering activities from concept and feasibility studies through execution.
• Act as the interface between engineering, production, and project management teams.
• Support the delivery of multidisciplinary installations, including civil works, mechanical equipment, utilities, and electrical systems.
• Monitor project planning, technical coordination, and execution to ensure objectives are met.
• Contribute to the successful implementation of brownfield CAPEX projects within an operational production environment.

• Master's or Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, or a multidisciplinary engineering background with a strong civil engineering foundation.
• Proven experience as a Project Engineer on industrial CAPEX projects, ideally in brownfield environments.
• Strong understanding of civil engineering with the ability to coordinate multidisciplinary technical activities.
• Excellent coordination and communication skills, with the ability to work across multiple stakeholders.
• Fluent in Dutch and English (mandatory).

Company Activities:

Our client is part of the circular economy based on wood fibers. In Belgium, the company has three units employing around 600 employees. The plant in Langerbrugge (Ghent) produces high-quality newspaper and magazine paper from 100% recycled paper. Thanks to two biomass power plants that provide the necessary process steam and three wind turbines, the company is one of the most sustainable enterprises in North Sea Port. Safety is the top priority, and thanks to intensive training programs, employees develop both professionally and personal

Jobomschrijving

Our client, a leading global producer of renewable solutions for paper, packaging, pulp, and wood constructions, is looking for an Electrical Maintenance Technician. In this role, you will be responsible for managing and maintaining the electrical network up to a voltage level of 150 kV.

Your daily tasks will include:
	
• Managing the lighting network.	
• Maintaining fire detection systems.	
• Operating frequency converters (ABB, Siemens, Danfoss).	
• Controlling various types of power switches (Siemens, ABB).

The ideal candidate should:
	
• Hold a Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent experience.	
• Have several years of experience in a similar role in an industrial production environment.	
• Be passionate about electricity and keep up-to-date with the latest trends in the field.	
• Think pragmatically and solve problems.	
• Plan and organize work effectively, with a focus on achieving results.	
• Communicate in English or Dutch at a good level.

As a machine operator in our modern citrus department, you play a crucial role in operating and optimizing automated production and packaging lines. You use MES software to monitor and improve the performance of machines and production lines. Together with your team, you ensure a smooth workflow and high-quality end products.

Your day consists of setting up, adjusting, and operating machines, timely providing materials, and guiding colleagues on the line. You work closely with the technical department in case of malfunctions and regularly perform minor maintenance tasks. Additionally, you register production data and help maintain order and cleanliness in the workplace.

Are you a team player who likes to take initiative and think about improvements? Do you want to work in a growing department within a stable company? Apply now and discover your opportunities as a machine operator in our citrus department!

• At least lower secondary education
• Experience as an operator is required (0-1 year welcome)
• Good knowledge of English (spoken and written)
• Willingness to work in a two-shift system (sometimes three shifts) and weekends
• Team-oriented and communicative
• Accurate and safety-conscious
• Proactive and solution-oriented

International company in Brussels. 

Jobomschrijving

We are looking for an Administrative Assistant with over 2 years of experience in administration for our client.

What are your tasks?
	
• Keep agendas up-to-date and ensure consistency amongst Executives’ activities	
• Follow-up meetings/conferences/registrations and invitation to meetings/conferences etc.	
• Arrange travel plans (flights, hotel reservations etc.).	
• Format documents and send e-mail/letters	
• Assist with the preparation and the formatting of presentations (PowerPoint)	
• Keep our SharePoint up-to-date with meeting materials etc.	
• Keep our contact database up to date	
• Follow up of contracts with external parties and ensure their appropriate recording in the contract database.	
• Collecting and providing all relevant information for internal/external meetings	
• Sending outlook invitations and tracking replies	
• Gathering working documents, preparing meeting folders and checking presentations’ accuracy	
• Organizing Microsoft Teams meetings when relevant	
• Ordering lunches	
• Setting up meeting rooms for calls and face to face meetings	
• Answer phone calls and welcome visitors

Skills & Competences:
	
• You possess a degree/diploma/certificate in Administration or relevant	
• At least 2 years of experience	
• Past experience of working in an international environment is an asset	
• Excellent spoken and written in English, dutch and french is a prerequisite	
• Excellent computer skills (Word, PowerPoint, Excel…)	
• Team worker	
• Being proactive	
• Good oral and written communication abilities	
• Flexible, diplomatic, with good cultural sensitivity o Independent and autonomous	
• Eager to learn	
• Able to respect deadlines and tight timing

Our client is an innovative SME located in the Maldegem region, specialising in the design, development and installation of high-tech test and measurement equipment for the agricultural sector. Their tailor-made solutions are used worldwide by machine manufacturers, universities and testing centres to accurately test, measure and optimise agricultural machinery. By combining engineering, machine building and automation, they deliver customised projects for customers across the globe.

Jobomschrijving

As a Project Engineer Machine Building, you will be involved in the complete development of innovative machines and testing systems. From the initial concept to the final installation at the customer's site, you will play an active role throughout the entire project lifecycle. This is a varied position combining engineering, assembly, testing and international commissioning.

As a Project Engineer Machine Building, your responsibilities include:

• Developing and improving new machines and technical solutions.
• Building, assembling and testing prototypes.
• Installing, commissioning and fine-tuning equipment at customer sites both nationally and internationally.
• Analysing technical issues and proposing improvements to products and processes.
• Preparing technical documentation, manuals and work instructions.
• Collaborating closely with colleagues from engineering, production and service departments.
• Providing technical support during demonstrations, trade fairs and commercial activities.

For this positFor this position as Project Engineer Machine Building, we are looking for an all-round engineer who enjoys combining theory with hands-on technical work. You like taking ownership of projects from start to finish and are willing to travel internationally on a regular basis.

As a Project Engineer Machine Building, you have:

• A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electromechanics, Mechanical Engineering, Product Development, Machine Building or a related technical field.
• A strong interest in machine building, automation and product development.
• A hands-on mentality and practical approach to engineering.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Willingness to travel internationally for installations and commissioning projects.
• A good command of English.
• Knowledge of Dutch is mandatory.
• A valid Category B driving licence.
For this position as Project Engineer Machine Building, we are looking for an all-round engineer who enjoys combining theory with hands-on technical work. You like taking ownership of projects from start to finish and are willing to travel internationally on a regular basis.

As a Project Engineer Machine Building, you have:

• A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electromechanics, Mechanical Engineering, Product Development, Machine Building or a related technical field.
• A strong interest in machine building, automation and product development.
• A hands-on mentality and practical approach to engineering.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Willingness to travel internationally for installations and commissioning projects.
• A good command of English.
• A valid Category B driving licence.

Our client is a leading international corporate real estate company. You will join a company offering a stable environment, strong team spirit and opportunities to develop your skills. They are located in Diegem close to a train station in a new modern building.

Jobomschrijving

As Meetings & Event Coordinator, you will ensure successful planning and execution of meetings and events.

• Coordinate and support delivery of meetings, conferences and events from planning to execution.
• Prepare and set up meeting rooms and event spaces.
• Coordinate guest services, catering, transportation and other event-related logistics.
• Manage meetings and events calendar and contribute to post-event reporting and follow-up.
• Support in general office management.

• First experience in events, hospitality, office management or administration is a plus (internships included).
• Fluent in Dutch, French and English.
• Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail.
• Service-oriented mindset and professional communication skills.
• Proactive, hands-on and able to work in a fast-paced environment.
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications (Outlook, Word and Excel).

Our client is a growing technology company based in the heart of Brussels, developing business-critical solutions within a highly regulated and fast-evolving environment.Technology is at the core of its strategy, with several exciting projects planned over the coming years, including a significant migration towards AWS.

Jobomschrijving

They are looking for a Senior PHP Developer to join their engineering team and play a key role in the evolution of business-critical applications. The successful candidate will work on backend development with PHP and Laravel, contribute to a major AWS migration project, and progressively become a technical reference within the team
 

• Develop and maintain scalable backend applications using PHP and Laravel.
• Participate in the modernization of the technology stack and cloud migration initiatives.
• Collaborate closely with technical leadership on architectural decisions.
• Ensure code quality through reviews, testing, and best development practices.
• Analyse business needs and translate them into robust technical solutions.
• Troubleshoot complex technical issues and propose long-term improvements.
• Contribute to system reliability, security, and performance optimization.
• Share knowledge and support the growth of the development team.

• Minimum 7 years of software development experience.
• Strong expertise in PHP and Laravel.
• Experience working on complex business applications.
• Ability to work independently and quickly identify priorities.
• Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
• Professional English communication skills.
• You can quickly understand an existing ecosystem and become a key contributor.

• You enjoy working with experienced engineers in a collaborative and low-ego environment.

About the Company:

Our client, headquartered in Zwijnaarde, is a leading global biotechnology company introducing groundbreaking cell therapy to Ghent. Their dedicated team plays a crucial role in improving the lives of patients battling cancer and other severe illnesses. As they continue to grow, they are looking for motivated and committed individuals to join their dynamic workforce.

Jobomschrijving

For our client, an innovative and rapidly expanding biotech company, we are currently seeking a Warehouse Associate.

Responsibilities:

As a Warehouse Associate, you will be responsible for:
	
• Handling biohazard materials such as blood bags and viral vectors in a temperature-controlled environment.	
• Accurately processing incoming inventory by verifying purchase orders, conducting quality checks, and ensuring compliance with company policies.	
• Managing equipment and materials stored at cryogenic temperatures.	
• Completing Master Inspection Checks (MIC) for received goods, including transportation inspections, temperature control, integrity verification, and proper documentation.	
• Filling in necessary forms and logbooks related to receiving, picking, and outbound operations in accordance with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and Good Documentation Practices (GDP).	
• Collaborating closely with the Operations and Quality departments to facilitate production and laboratory activities at the start-up site.	
• Working in a sterile environment while wearing specialized protective clothing.	
• Using two SAP Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems to manage inbound, picking, and outbound logistics.	
• Coordinating with accounting, suppliers, and business stakeholders to enhance operational efficiency.

Candidate Profile:
	
• High school diploma or associate’s degree.	
• Prior warehouse experience, preferably within the pharmaceutical industry.	
• Strong attention to detail with the ability to complete administrative tasks such as filling out forms and maintaining logbooks.	
• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively across various levels of the organization.	
• Problem-solving mindset with solid analytical and data interpretation skills.	
• Strict adherence to protocols to ensure product quality and personal safety at all times.	
• Ability to work independently while maintaining a high level of responsibility.	
• Proficiency in English is essential.

Our client, company founded in 1948, is a Belgian family business specializing in exterior joinery. Their  Group covers a range of production units. The business unit Extrusion & Finishing extrudes, anodizes and enamels aluminum profiles. Our client specializes in custom-made exterior joinery in PVC, aluminum and wood. In addition to windows and doors, many additional products are also made, such as garage doors, roller shutters and ventilation systems.

Jobomschrijving

Job Description:

Without solid maintenance, there is no quality! As a maintenance technician, you will be responsible for monitoring wear and tear, tracking faults, analyzing causes, proposing solutions, and optimizing production processes. Your tasks will include:
	
• Routine inspections and preventive maintenance.	
• Risk analysis.	
• Working with top-quality machines and equipment.
By collaborating with external partners, you will have the opportunity to critically assess our client’s processes and advise management and production personnel on improving their machinery park. Working in their team also means continuous development, both individually and as part of a team

Candidate Profile:
	
• Preferred education: Bachelor’s degree in electromechanics, industrial engineering, or equivalent experience.	
• Open to all levels of experience - from junior to experienced specialists.	
• Commitment and practical approach to work.	
• Solid knowledge of mechanics, electricity, and pneumatics.	
• Curiosity and passion for technology.	
• Attention to accuracy and safety in the workplace.	
• Flexibility and willingness to work in shifts.	
• Precision, attention to detail, and efficiency.	
• Teamwork and communication skills.	
• Openness to participating in the on-call system.	
• Basic/communicative knowledge of Dutch or English.

Our client is a european fintech operating in the financial services and payments sector. Its Brussels-based offices offer a dynamic, modern and easily accessible working environment within a rapidly evolving industry.

Jobomschrijving

• Act as the AML Compliance Officer and oversee the organisation's AML/CFT framework
• Supervise KYC, CDD, sanctions screening, PEP reviews and transaction monitoring activities
• Manage, coach and develop a team of 6 compliance professionals
• Review and validate complex investigations and escalate sensitive cases when required
• Maintain and enhance AML/CFT policies, procedures and internal controls
• Coordinate regulatory reporting, audits and compliance reviews
• Collaborate closely with legal, risk and operational teams to ensure regulatory compliance

• Unlimited right to work in Belgium is mandatory for this position : applications without a valid work permit will not be considered.

• Degree in Law, Finance, Compliance, Risk Management or a related field
• Minimum 7 years of experience in AML/CFT, compliance or financial crime within financial services, payments or fintech
• Fluent in English; proficiency in French and/or Dutch is considered an advantage
• Strong knowledge of Belgian and European AML regulations, KYC/CDD, sanctions and transaction monitoring
• Excellent analytical, communication and stakeholder management skills
• Proven experience leading and developing compliance teams

Responsibilities

• Act as the primary business lead and Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for assigned feature areas within the transformation program.
• Drive business engagement across local, regional, and external stakeholder groups throughout the project lifecycle.
• Coordinate business activities during the design, build, testing, deployment, and hypercare phases.
• Elicit, analyze, and document business requirements, producing deliverables such as BRDs, user stories, and process flows.
• Review solution proposals from a business perspective and challenge designs to ensure they meet operational needs.
• Define business acceptance criteria and coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to ensure successful process validation.
• Assess operational impacts and identify requirements for training, communication, and change readiness to support solution adoption.

Requirements

• 5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Process Analyst, or Product Analyst.
• Experience working within large-scale ERP, digital, or business transformation programs.
• Proven expertise in documenting business requirements using BRDs, user stories, process flows, and functional specifications.
• Strong background in stakeholder management and facilitating complex workshop facilitation sessions.
• Experience with governance support, including tracking decisions, risks, and dependencies for steering committees.
• Ability to translate complex business needs into actionable delivery requirements and technical specifications.
• Proactive and self-managing with the ability to operate effectively in ambiguous environments.
• Excellent communication and relationship-building skills with a delivery-focused mindset.
• You are fluent in English.
Nice to Haves

• Experience within the retail industry.
• Knowledge of POS systems, merchandising, pricing, or supply chain.
• Experience with SAP or other major retail platforms and omnichannel commerce solutions.
• Knowledge of data and reporting solutions and master data management.

The hiring company is a multinational organization with a long-standing presence in the global market.

Jobomschrijving

• Oversee day-to-day IT operations, ensuring reliable infrastructure and support services.
• Manage and maintain server environments, network infrastructure, VPN connectivity, and security solutions.
• Provide technical support and troubleshooting for end users and business-critical systems.
• Support enterprise applications, user access management, and system integrations.
• Implement and monitor backup, recovery, and cybersecurity processes.
• Maintain IT asset inventories, software licensing records, and technical documentation.
• Coordinate with external vendors and service providers for maintenance and support activities.
• Support internal audits, compliance requirements, and IT governance initiatives.
• Identify and implement improvements to enhance system performance, security, and operational efficiency.

To apply online please click the 'Apply' button below. For a confidential discussion about this role please contact Gift Petto on +66 2 012 5067.

• Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
• 5-7+ years of experience in IT infrastructure, systems administration, networking, or IT operations.
• Strong knowledge of Windows and/or Linux server administration.
• Experience supporting network environments including LAN, WAN, VPN, and security technologies.
• Familiarity with ERP systems, databases, and cloud platforms is an advantage.
• Good understanding of IT service management, security, and compliance practices.
• Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
• Effective communication skills in Thai and English.

jobs.occupation: Warehouse job: order picker in day shift
jobs.description:
Are you already familiar with orderpicking and logistics? And are you looking for a stable and physically engaging role with job security? And do you like great hours to get a good work-life balance? Then this is an excellent opportunity for you!

For a large and growing logistics in Oostkamp specialised in frozen goods, we're looking for an orderpicker to join the day shift team in the freezer warehouse. Do cold temperatures not scare you at all and do you speak English well? Then don't hesitate to apply, because the company is very welcoming to speakers of Dutch and English!

The job

As an orderpicker, you play a crucial part in the company’s logistical process. You work in the freezer every day to prepare orders for supermarkets throughout Europe.

Your responsibilites include:

• Making orders based on order lists
• Preparing completed orders for shipment
• Taking the orders to the loading docks for the trucks
You do all of this using an electrical pallet truck (also known as an "EPT").

Be sure to apply if you:

• Have experience in orderpicking or other warehouse work
• Aren't afraid of physically heavy work in a freezer environment
• Have your own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)
Experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT) is a big plus, but not required.

!! Please note: you need to live in Belgium for this job. Actief cannot help you immigrate nor provide housing. If you don't have an official address in Belgium, you don't qualify and cannot apply !!
